name: material-theme
description: Atom's iconic One Dark theme for Visual Studio Code
readme:
# One Dark Pro

Atom's iconic One Dark color theme: **One Dark Pro**, Flat, Darker, Mix and Night Flat. After installing, reload the window and pick a theme with `Preferences: Color Theme` (Ctrl+K Ctrl+T), or set `"workbench.colorTheme": "One Dark Pro"` in settings.json.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode. The themes are verified with their default options; the extension options that regenerate the theme files were not checked in Diode.
